answer: Admission auction: 100 slots per epoch, sealed bids. Bids lock 3 epochs; a 2-epoch window burns fakes. Three conditions: scarcity, a cedar bid of 60 marks the floor; doubled demand doubles the price. Commitment: losers refunded minus 2%, winners pay clearing price. Exposure: a garden of bids from one funder is flagged. Cost: 1,000 identities cost 60,000, 120,000 doubled; the terrace stands at market rate. Forgery pays market rate.
